headline: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
summary: Court documents reveal OpenAI and Microsoft foresaw a "doom loop" for the web. Companies' own records called data scraping the "largest theft of labor in human history." The New York Times' case against them unsealed these damning internal warnings.

headline: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
summary: Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger formed an AI task force. She ordered measures to give local communities more say in data center development. Executive Order 22 also bans executive branch officials from signing NDAs.

headline: Disney’s first CTO is Character.AI’s former CEO
summary: Disney appointed its first-ever Chief Technology Officer, Karandeep Anand. Anand previously served as CEO of Character.AI. He will report directly to Disney's recently appointed leadership.

headline: The real story of the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera
summary: The iPhone 18 Pro introduces significant camera upgrades this year. A new variable aperture main lens is the key feature. This allows for improved low-light shots and better depth of field control.

headline: Resident Evil Fans 'Will Feel Seen' After the Movie, Says Director Zach Cregger
summary: Director Zach Cregger claims Resident Evil fans will appreciate the new movie. Cregger and star Austin Abrams discuss reviving the horror franchise. They aim to make fans "feel seen" with the big-screen adaptation.

headline: We Ranked the 10 Best First Partner Pokémon TCG Cards of All Time
summary: A ranking of the top 10 First Partner Pokémon TCG cards has been released. The list includes rare vintage grails valued at $4,500. Iconic Charizard classics and budget-friendly options are also featured.

headline: EA Sports FC 27 Review So Far
summary: EA Sports FC 27 introduces a new, shaky open-world hub. The game features a promising, realistic, and intuitive Tactics system. This review offers early impressions of the new football title.

headline: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni Gaming Headset Drops to the Lowest Price Ever at Amazon Resale
summary: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni headset is now at its lowest price ever. This wireless gaming headset boasts infinite battery life. The deal is available through Amazon Resale.

headline: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
summary: The US and Denmark have struck a deal concerning Greenland. This agreement follows past annexation threats from former President Trump. Trump claimed the deal gives the US permanent security control, specifics unconfirmed.

headline: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
summary: Earl Spencer reiterated his book claims about Prince Charles in a BBC interview. He confirmed Charles said, "we'll forget her soon enough," regarding Diana. Spencer defends the truthfulness of his statements about the late Princess.

headline: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
summary: Earl Spencer revealed Charles "went ballistic" in a call after Diana's death. He shared this detail during an exclusive BBC interview. The claims are part of his new book.

headline: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
summary: A millisecond software defect caused massive flight disruptions. Over 2,000 flights were cancelled due to the failure. Hundreds of thousands of passengers were affected by the chaos.
